A '''chemical tracer''' was a substance that could be used to track down stolen items. It could be used to lace certain items, such as pieces of a private [[Collector/Legends|collection]] of valuables, after which they could be tracked via the use of a scanner.<ref name="Journal11">{{JournalCite|11|The Farrimmer Cafe}}</ref>
